items.title: Add compact query guidance to agent prompt templates
items.context: Use the accepted B-f495 plan. Prefer a shared prompt-registry guidance block when possible, then keep package templates and generated Claude/Codex mirrors consistent.
items.userSees: The shared prompt guidance includes: "For routine status refreshes, prefer compact read-only queries" and includes full-output fallback commands.

happy.desc: Load-bearing agent prompt templates include compact story_get/checklist_get examples for routine status refreshes.

edge.desc: The same guidance also states full output must be reloaded before evidence-sensitive conclusions or mutations.

adversarial.desc: Claude and Codex mirrors match package templates and do not drift from the prompt registry render output.

items.title: Update routine documentation examples
items.context: Change only examples used for routine orientation. Keep full story_get/checklist_get examples where complete evidence or mutation decisions require full data.
items.userSees: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md routine orientation examples show slim / fields commands, while evidence-sensitive examples still show full output.

happy.desc: Routine orientation examples in project guidance use slim / fields forms for story_get/checklist_get where full data is not required.

edge.desc: Full-output examples remain present where the surrounding text requires complete evidence, mutation decisions, or detailed history.

adversarial.desc: Documentation does not claim provider billing savings, Authority completion, DONE semantic changes, or default output changes.

items.title: Add regression coverage for compact guidance
items.context: Extend prompt-token-cost-smoke or a focused smoke so future edits cannot remove compact guidance or the full-output fallback from package templates and mirrors.
items.userSees: prompt-token-cost-smoke fails if compact query guidance or the evidence-sensitive full-output fallback is missing from load-bearing templates or mirrors.

happy.desc: prompt-token-cost-smoke asserts compact-query guidance exists in every load-bearing package template.

edge.desc: prompt-token-cost-smoke asserts the full-output fallback exists with evidence-sensitive wording.

adversarial.desc: The smoke still verifies default story_get/checklist_get compatibility and slim output remains smaller than full output.

items.title: Verify Codex adapter and prompt registry consistency
items.context: Because package templates and .Codex/.claude mirrors may change, run build, prompt registry smoke, prompt token smoke, and verify_codex.
items.userSees: Verification output includes build success, prompt-token-cost-smoke pass, prompt-registry-smoke pass, and verify_codex adapter checks passed.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build passes before built dist smoke tasks are executed.

edge.desc: prompt-registry-smoke passes, proving package templates render consistently for Claude and Codex mirrors.

adversarial.desc: verify_codex --json passes after Codex-facing prompt assets change and reports adapter checks passed.
